title: kbmon's coord panel takes about 8 s to collect on this clone, so the sessions and sprint panels time out in --status all and the session-start receipt
goal: kbmon's coord panel collects within 3 s alone on this clone's coord store (2026-11-08: 2418 own/, 423 run/ and 107 ask/ keys, list 664 KB, event log 739 KB), so --status all and --receipt read every panel within the default 10 s budget (kbmon.py DEFAULT_TIMEOUT) on a calm host: on 2026-11-08 coord collect took 8.35 s alone (8.4 s user CPU), and with all panels as threads under one deadline (mon_base) the sessions and sprint panels timed out, --status said 'not readable (timeout)' and --status coord silently dropped its run-state drift line (mon_status returns [] when sessions is unread). The cause is profiled first (with_silence in mon_coord is the suspect); the fix keeps every line coord shows today. Planning measures the run-to-run spread of coord collect before setting the margin.
